content.opening: Welcome to our commercial model overview. We focus on providing transparent and scalable solutions for businesses of all sizes.
content.section1Text: Our business structure is designed to optimize costs and improve efficiency.

q1.question: What is included in the commercial model?
q1.answer: Our model includes full end-to-end support for customs clearance and logistics.

q2.question: Are there any hidden fees?
q2.answer: No, all pricing is transparent and provided upfront.

q3.question: How long does it take to get started?
q3.answer: You can be onboarded within a matter of days.

q4.question: Do you offer custom models for large enterprises?
q4.answer: Yes, we tailor our solutions for high-volume enterprise clients.
